name: Fail-safe Detonator
community_notes: [APPROX] Used when a Battlesuit model is destroyed: if it has Deadly Demise, choose the roll result to be 1 or 6 instead of rolling; otherwise roll one D6 per unit within 6" and on a 4+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Encoded as an opaque grant.

name: Grav-Inhibitor Field
community_notes: Used just after an enemy unit declares a charge against the Battlesuit unit: that enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test and you roll one D6 per model in it, suffering 1 mortal wound per 6.

name: The Arro'kon Protocol
community_notes: Applies only against enemy units containing 6 or more models; against units of 11 or more models the attacks gain [SUSTAINED HITS 2] instead. The model-count scaling is not encoded.

name: The Shortened Blade
community_notes: A unit arriving via Deep Strike can be set up more than 6" horizontally from all enemy models; it cannot declare a charge this turn.

name: The Torchstar Gambit
community_notes: After its attacks are resolved, an unengaged unit can make a Normal move but cannot declare a charge this turn.

name: Aggressive Mobility
community_notes: If the unit Advances, no Advance roll is made; instead add 6" to the Move characteristic of its models until the end of the phase.

name: Combat Debarkation
community_notes: Applies only to attacks that target the closest enemy unit; the closest-target gate is not encoded.

name: Focused Fire
community_notes: Targets two T'au Empire units and one enemy unit: both units can only attack that enemy unit this phase, with AP improved by 1. Cannot be used in the fourth or fifth battle rounds.

name: Pinpoint Counter-Offensive
community_notes: Used on a just-destroyed T'au Empire unit (excluding Kroot): for the rest of the battle, T'au Empire units (excluding Kroot) re-roll Hit rolls against the enemy unit that destroyed it.

name: Pulse Onslaught
community_notes: The selected enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) hit by this unit's attacks is shaken until the end of your opponent's next turn.

name: A Trap Well Laid
community_notes: Applies to attacks made by Kroot models against the selected unit, unless the attacking unit is Battle-shocked.

name: EMP Grenades
community_notes: Worsens the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of the selected enemy Vehicle unit's weapons by 1 (higher is worse).

name: Hidden Hunters
community_notes: The unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

name: Join the Hunt
community_notes: [APPROX] Used on a just-destroyed Kroot Infantry or Kroot Hounds unit: add an identical unit to your army in Strategic Reserves at Starting Strength. Cannot return destroyed Character units to Attached units. Encoded as an opaque grant.

name: The Grisly Feast
community_notes: Used on a unit that destroyed an enemy unit this Fight phase: in the opponent's next Command phase each enemy unit within 6" takes a Battle-shock test (-1 if Below Half-strength) and skips its other Battle-shock tests that phase.

name: A Tempting Trap
community_notes: The first use designates one objective marker outside the opponent's deployment zone as your Trap objective; the bonus applies only to ranged attacks against enemy units within range of it. Cannot be used in the first or second battle rounds.

name: Combat Embarkation
community_notes: [APPROX] Used just after an enemy unit declares a charge against this unit: the unit embarks within a friendly Transport if every model is within 3" of it and capacity suffices. Encoded as an opaque grant.

name: Coordinate to Engage
community_notes: Used on a unit just selected as an Observer: its attacks against their Spotted unit have Ballistic Skill improved by 1 and, if the unit has Markerlight, [IGNORES COVER].

name: Photon Grenades
community_notes: Used just after an enemy unit declares a charge against this unengaged unit: the charging unit takes a Battle-shock test and has -2 to Charge rolls this phase.

name: Point-Blank Ambush
community_notes: Applies only to ranged attacks against enemy units within 9"; cannot be used in the first or second battle rounds.

name: Wall of Mirrors
community_notes: At the end of the opponent's Fight phase, one unengaged Stealth, Ghostkeel or Commander Shadowsun unit is placed into Strategic Reserves.

name: Alien Expertise
community_notes: Kroot or Vespid Stingwings unit only; the Advance move does not prevent the unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

name: Experimental Modifications
community_notes: Kroot or Vespid Stingwings unit only; applies to the unit's attacks when selected to attack in the Shooting or Fight phase.

name: Guided By Unity
community_notes: Applies only to ranged attacks against units within 9" of a friendly Kroot or Vespid Stingwings unit; the proximity gate is not encoded. Cannot target Kroot or Vespid Stingwings units.

name: Rapid Acquisition
community_notes: At the end of your Movement phase, one objective the unit controls becomes secured.

name: Suppressing Fire
community_notes: One enemy unit hit by this unit's attacks is pinned (-2" Move) until the start of your next Command phase.

name: Swift Embarkation
community_notes: At the end of the opponent's Fight phase, an unengaged unit that was eligible to fight, wholly within 6" of a friendly Sudden Dawn Cadre Transport it can embark within, embarks within it.

name: Puretide Engram Neurochip
community_notes: Each time you target the bearer's unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 4+ you gain 1 CP.

name: Starflare Ignition System
community_notes: At the end of the opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is unengaged, it can be removed from the battlefield and placed into Strategic Reserves.

name: Internal Grenade Racks
community_notes: The mortal wounds trigger each time the bearer ends a Normal move, against one enemy unit it moved over: roll six D6, 1 mortal wound per 4+.

name: Prototype Weapon System
community_notes: Selected each time the bearer is selected to shoot; applies to the bearer's ranged weapons until those attacks are resolved.

name: Exemplar of the Mont'ka
community_notes: While the bearer is leading a unit, the Killing Blow detachment rule applies to that unit during the fourth battle round as well. Kroot Shaper models cannot take this.

name: Strike Swiftly
community_notes: In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, up to two friendly T'au Empire units within 6" that lack Scouts gain the Scouts 6" ability.

name: Strategic Conqueror
community_notes: [APPROX] At the start of the first battle round select one objective marker; while the bearer is on the battlefield, friendly T'au Empire models within range of it get +1 Objective Control. Encoded as an opaque grant.

name: Coordinated Exploitation
community_notes: [APPROX] While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer, ranged weapons of a Guided unit gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] while targeting their Spotted unit. Encoded as an opaque grant. Kroot Shaper models cannot take this.

name: Kroothawk Flock
community_notes: Enemy units arriving as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of the bearer; encoded as an opaque grant.

name: Root-carved Weapons
community_notes: Applies to all weapons equipped by the bearer.

name: Borthrod Gland
community_notes: While the bearer is leading a unit, melee attacks made by models in that unit score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

name: Supernova Launcher
community_notes: Applies to one Airbursting Fragmentation Projector selected in the Declare Battle Formations step; the weapon-name scoping is not encoded.

name: Thermoneutronic Projector
community_notes: Applies to one T'au Flamer selected in the Declare Battle Formations step; the weapon-name scoping is not encoded.

name: Plasma Accelerator Rifle
community_notes: Applies to one Plasma Rifle selected in the Declare Battle Formations step; the weapon-name scoping is not encoded.

name: Exemplar of the Kauyon
community_notes: While the bearer is leading a unit, the Patient Hunter detachment rule applies to that unit from the second battle round instead of the third. Kroot Shaper models cannot take this.

name: Precision of the Patient Hunter
community_notes: From the third battle round onwards, also add 1 to the Wound roll; the round-gated wound bonus is not encoded.

name: Solid-image Projection Unit
community_notes: After deployment, redeploy up to three T'au Empire units, optionally into Strategic Reserves regardless of the usual limits.

name: Through Unity, Devastation
community_notes: [APPROX] While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer, ranged weapons of a Guided unit gain [LETHAL HITS] while targeting their Spotted unit. Encoded as an opaque grant. Kroot Shaper models cannot take this.

name: Student of Kauyon
community_notes: [APPROX] In the Declare Battle Formations step, up to three friendly Kroot Carnivores or Farstalker Kinband units gain Deep Strike. Encoded as an opaque grant.

name: Admired Leader
community_notes: In your Command phase, one Kroot or Vespid Stingwings unit within 12" gets improved Leadership (encoded as -1, lower is better) and +1 Objective Control until the start of your next Command phase. Kroot models cannot take this.

name: Earth Caste Modifications
community_notes: [APPROX] After this unit shoots, one enemy unit hit is suppressed (-1 to Hit rolls) until the start of your next turn; and this unit's ingress moves can be set up more than 6" (instead of 8") from enemies at the cost of not charging that turn. Both encoded as opaque grants.

name: Proximity Scanners
community_notes: [APPROX] Unit Upgrade (Devilfish unit, not a Character Enhancement): when a friendly unit disembarks from this unit, its pulse blaster and pulse carbine weapons get +1 Attacks. Encoded as an opaque grant.
